### Observation Log

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/23 (Tue) 20:30
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided three options for application architecture: LAMP Stack, MEAN Stack, and Serverless Architecture.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] LAMP Stack pros: Cost-effective, flexibility, well-established.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] LAMP Stack cons: Scalability issues, security vulnerabilities, learning curve for new developers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MEAN Stack pros: Modern architecture, flexibility, scalability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MEAN Stack cons: Learning curve for developers, fewer resources compared to LAMP, complexity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Serverless Architecture pros: Scalability, reduced infrastructure costs, reduced maintenance burden.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Serverless Architecture cons: Learning curve, limited control over infrastructure, potential vendor lock-in.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended using the LAMP stack based on the project purpose, requirements, and constraints.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided additional architecture options: Monolithic Architecture, Microservices Architecture, Django, Ruby on Rails, and .NET.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Monolithic Architecture pros: Simple to develop, deploy, and manage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Monolithic Architecture cons: Difficult to scale, maintain, and update.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Microservices Architecture pros: Highly scalable, easy to maintain and update, independent services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Microservices Architecture cons: Complex to develop and deploy, requires more resources.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Django pros: Python-based, large number of libraries, modular and scalable, built-in admin interface.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Django cons: May be overkill for simple projects, not as performant, limited customization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ruby on Rails pros: Highly productive, includes pre-built tools, large community support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ruby on Rails cons: Difficult to scale and maintain for larger applications, can be slow to start.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] .NET pros: Highly scalable, good for complex applications, large community support.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] .NET cons: Can be expensive to license, requires specific skills, difficult to set up.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant outlined steps to create user interface wireframes, including reviewing project requirements, researching best practices, determining tools, sketching layouts, creating detailed wireframes, gathering feedback, and finalizing documentation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized the importance of gathering feedback from stakeholders and
